He later died after being implicated in a case.
s0266 後坐累死 uses 坐累 for implication/entanglement in a case with fatal consequence; 'died from overwork' invents a false cause. The proposed idiomatic correctly renders implication leading to death.
Later, on a charge of overwork he died.
Later he died after being implicated in a case.
The literal's 'charge of overwork' misreads 坐累 as a labor-related offense; 坐累 is implication in a case. The proposed literal correctly states death after implication.
He was ordered to be seized by Zhou Yuan, chiliarch of the Embroidered Uniform Guard.
Zhou Yuan, a chiliarch of the Embroidered Uniform Guard, was ordered to go arrest them.
s0290 命錦衣衛千戶周原往捕之 orders Zhou Yuan to go arrest them (之); the before text wrongly makes the accused the patient of 命. The proposed literal restores Zhou Yuan as the officer ordered to arrest.

Yongzhou Prefect Yu Yancheng, Qidong Magistrate Zheng Min, and ten others were imprisoned on charges; the people of their districts listed their administrative achievements in petition, and all were restored to office.

Yongzhou Prefect Yu Yancheng, Qidong Magistrate Zheng Min, and others—ten men in all—were imprisoned on charges; the people of their districts listed their administrative achievements in petition, and all were restored to office.
s0314 余彥誠、鄭敏等十人 means ten men in total including the named officials; 'ten others' would add ten beyond Yu and Zheng. The proposed literal correctly counts ten in all.
Yichun Magistrate Shen Chang and four others were further promoted to prefects.
Yichun Magistrate Shen Chang and three others were further promoted to prefects.
s0315 沈昌等四人 means four persons total including Shen Chang; 'four others' overcounts. The proposed literal correctly has Shen Chang and three others.
